The '''2007 [[Tippeligaen]]''' was the 63rd completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. The season began on 9 April 2007. Originally scheduled to end on 4 November, the last round was moved to Saturday 3 November 2007, due to [[Rosenborg BK|Rosenborg]]’s [[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] participation.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20071010104729/http://www.fotball.no/t2.aspx?p=51834&x=1&a=205207&cat=51834|title="Siste serierunde flyttet"}}, ''NFF'', 31 August 2007. Retrieved 3 September 2007</ref>

[[SK Brann|Brann]] were confirmed as league champions after the 24th round of the season, after [[Stabæk Fotball|Stabæk]] lost away to [[Viking FK|Viking]]. The result left Brann with an unassailable seven-point lead over Viking, with two games left to play. Brann thus claimed their first league title since 1963, and their third league title in all. Stabæk eventually finished as runners-up, their strongest performance ever, while Viking finished third.

[[Sandefjord Fotball|Sandefjord]] and [[IK Start|Start]] ended the season at the bottom of the table and were relegated. The play-off spot was occupied by [[Odd Grenland]] for the second year in a row. They faced [[FK Bodø/Glimt|Bodø/Glimt]] over two games for the right to play in the [[2008 Tippeligaen]], but lost 4–2 on aggregate and were relegated, while Bodø/Glimt were promoted.

==Teams==
Fourteen teams competed in the league – the top twelve teams from the previous season, and two teams promoted from [[2006 1. divisjon|1. divisjon]].
